title: Anagram Check
description:
Given two strings $s$ and $t$ consisting of lowercase English letters, determine whether $t$ is an anagram of $s$.

Two strings are anagrams if one can be obtained by rearranging the letters of the other.
inputFormat:
The first line contains a string $s$ ($1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$) consisting of lowercase English letters.

The second line contains a string $t$ ($1 \leq |t| \leq 10^5$) consisting of lowercase English letters.
outputFormat: Print "YES" if the strings are anagrams, "NO" otherwise.
constraints:
$1 \leq |s|, |t| \leq 10^5$
Both strings consist of lowercase English letters.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of $n$ distinct integers and $q$ queries, for each query find the 1-indexed position of the target element in the array, or report that it does not exist.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$ ($1 \leq n, q \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array and the number of queries.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$) in strictly increasing order.

Each of the next $q$ lines contains a single integer $x$ ($-10^9 \leq x \leq 10^9$) — the query target.
outputFormat: For each query, print the 1-indexed position of $x$ in the array, or $-1$ if $x$ is not present.
constraints:
$1 \leq n, q \leq 10^5$
$-10^9 \leq a_i, x \leq 10^9$
All $a_i$ are distinct and sorted in increasing order.

title: Count Even and Odd
description: Given an array of $n$ integers, count how many of them are even and how many are odd.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print two space-separated integers — the count of even numbers and the count of odd numbers.

title: Most Frequent Element
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers, find the element that appears most frequently.

If there are multiple elements with the same highest frequency, print the smallest one.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the most frequent element. If there is a tie, print the smallest.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from the array by deleting some (possibly zero) elements without changing the order of the remaining elements.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Maximum Element
description: Given an array of $n$ integers, find the maximum element.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the maximum element of the array.

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
description:
Given two sorted arrays of integers, merge them into a single sorted array.

Both arrays are sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the first array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$) in non-decreasing order.

The third line contains an integer $m$ ($1 \leq m \leq 10^5$) — the size of the second array.

The fourth line contains $m$ space-separated integers $b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_m$ ($-10^9 \leq b_i \leq 10^9$) in non-decreasing order.
outputFormat: Print $n + m$ space-separated integers — the merged sorted array.
constraints:
$1 \leq n, m \leq 10^5$
$-10^9 \leq a_i, b_i \leq 10^9$
Both arrays are sorted in non-decreasing order.

title: Number of Islands
description:
Given a 2D grid of size $n \times m$ consisting of '1's (land) and '0's (water), count the number of islands.

An island is a group of '1's connected horizontally or vertically (not diagonally). The grid is surrounded by water on all sides.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$ ($1 \leq n, m \leq 500$) — the number of rows and columns.

Each of the next $n$ lines contains a string of $m$ characters, each being '0' or '1'.
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the number of islands.
constraints:
$1 \leq n, m \leq 500$
$n \times m \leq 250000$
Each cell is either '0' or '1'.

title: Palindrome Check
description:
Given a string $s$ consisting of lowercase English letters, determine whether it is a palindrome.

A string is a palindrome if it reads the same forwards and backwards.
inputFormat: The first line contains a single string $s$ ($1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$) consisting of lowercase English letters.
outputFormat: Print "YES" if the string is a palindrome, "NO" otherwise.
constraints:
$1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$
The string consists of lowercase English letters only.

title: Remove Duplicates
description:
Given a sorted array of $n$ integers, remove the duplicates in-place and print the unique elements.

The array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$) in non-decreasing order.
outputFormat:
On the first line, print $k$ — the number of unique elements.

On the second line, print the $k$ unique elements in their original order, separated by spaces.

title: Reverse Array
description: Given an array of $n$ integers, print the array in reverse order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print $n$ space-separated integers — the elements of the array in reverse order.

title: Sum of Array
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers, find their sum.

Note that the sum may be large, so use appropriate data types.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print a single integer — the sum of all elements.

title: Topological Sort
description:
Given a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, find a topological ordering of its vertices.

A topological ordering is a linear ordering of vertices such that for every directed edge $(u, v)$, vertex $u$ comes before vertex $v$.

If there are multiple valid orderings, print the lexicographically smallest one.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $0 \leq m \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of vertices and edges.

Each of the next $m$ lines contains two integers $u$ and $v$ ($1 \leq u, v \leq n$, $u \neq v$) — a directed edge from $u$ to $v$.

It is guaranteed that the graph is a DAG (no cycles) and contains no duplicate edges.
outputFormat: Print $n$ space-separated integers — the lexicographically smallest topological ordering of the vertices.
constraints:
$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$
$0 \leq m \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$
The graph is a DAG with no duplicate edges.

title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers and a target value $t$, find two distinct indices $i$ and $j$ ($1$-indexed) such that $a_i + a_j = t$.

It is guaranteed that exactly one solution exists.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $t$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $-2 \cdot 10^9 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^9$) — the size of the array and the target sum.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print two space-separated integers $i$ and $j$ ($1 \leq i < j \leq n$) — the 1-indexed positions of the two elements that sum to $t$.
constraints:
$2 \leq n \leq 10^5$
$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$
$-2 \cdot 10^9 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^9$
Exactly one valid pair exists.

title: Valid Parentheses
description:
Given a string $s$ consisting of characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string has valid (balanced) brackets.

A string is valid if:
- Open brackets are closed by the same type of brackets.
- Open brackets are closed in the correct order.
- Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.
inputFormat: The first line contains a single string $s$ ($1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$) consisting of characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'.
outputFormat: Print "YES" if the string has valid brackets, "NO" otherwise.
constraints:
$1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$
The string consists only of bracket characters: ()[]{}
